title: VTC Events — Check-in — List — payload
description: List an event''s check-ins for its door and its hosts: who came, how and when, and how many. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller, the event and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 100; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Events — Check-in — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/checkin/list/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/checkin/list/0.2#response.

checkedIn.description: How many registrations have a check-in.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
